# YRB Nova

> YRB Nova is a UK website design studio building fast, custom, mobile-friendly websites for small businesses, tradespeople and startups. Sites are built from scratch (not templates), with fixed prices from £350 and launch in 2-5 days.

## Services and pricing

- [Services & pricing](https://yrbnova.com/services.html): Basic £350, Standard £600, Premium £800 (one-off, fixed prices). All include a custom, mobile-friendly design and on-page SEO; Standard and Premium include revisions until the client is happy. Optional hosting & support: £10/month or £100/year.
- [Free website audit](https://yrbnova.com/free-website-audit.html): free review of an existing website with practical improvements.
- [Book a project](https://yrbnova.com/checkout.html): pay online and book a website project.
- [Web design in Leicester](https://yrbnova.com/web-design-leicester.html): Leicestershire-based studio serving local businesses.
- [Websites for electricians](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-electricians.html)
- [Websites for plumbers](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-plumbers.html)
- [Websites for plumbers in Leicester](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-plumbers-leicester.html): plumber websites plus the VoiceDesk AI receptionist for Leicester and Leicestershire.
- [Websites for restaurants and cafés](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-restaurants.html)
- [Websites for barbers](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-barbers.html)
- [Websites for cleaning companies](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-cleaners.html)
- [Web design in Loughborough](https://yrbnova.com/web-design-loughborough.html)
- [Web design in Nottingham](https://yrbnova.com/web-design-nottingham.html)

## AI receptionist

- [YRB VoiceDesk AI receptionist](https://yrbnova.com/voicedesk.html): answers calls 24/7, books appointments, transfers urgent calls to a human. £299/month + £500 setup (setup waived with a new website).
